_about: A layout file for the design bench (tools\hudbench\README.md): each line one number of a HUD 2 layout preset, as core\ui_meta.h holds it (from docs\UI_SPEC.json hud2_presets), changed for one bench run only. Names: build\bench\flbench.exe layout-names. This one lowers Standard's loadout panel in a fight from 0.15 to 0.12 of the screen's height.
